sn21.9:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Tisso Bhagavato pitucchāputto yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi dukkhī dummano assūni pavattayamāno || || 3 Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Tissam etad avoca || ||
sn21.9:1.3: Kiṃ nu kho tvaṃ Tissa ekam antaṃ nisinno dukkhī dummano assūni pavattayamāno ti || || 4
sn21.9:1.4: Tathā hi pana mam bhante bhikkhū samantā vācāya sannitodakena sañjambharim akaṃsūti || || 5
sn21.9:1.5: Tathā hi pana tvaṃ Tissa vattā no ca vacanakkhamo || || 6
sn21.9:1.6: Na kho te taṃ Tissa paṭirūpam kulaputassa saddhā agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajitassa yaṃ tvam vattā no vacanakkhamo || ||
sn21.9:1.7: Etaṃ kho te Tissa paṭirūpaṃ kulaputtassa saddhā agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajitassa
sn21.9:1.8: yaṃ tvaṃ vattā assa vacanakkhamo cā ti || || 7
sn21.9:2.2: idaṃ vatvāna Sugato athāparam etad avoca satthā || ||
